summary_en: Soda Nikka authorized acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (4.37% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 1.6 billion yen through market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6, 2026 to May 31, 2027 to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, Soda Nikka's Board of Directors resolved to acquire its own shares under the authority granted by Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied through Article 165. The company will repurchase up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares, representing 4.4% of outstanding shares (22,859,774 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 1.6 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using a commissioned trading arrangement with a securities company, commencing November 6, 2026 and continuing through May 31, 2027. The company stated that the purpose of the buyback is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
